findings.description: This is an incorrect Ukrainian collocation for answers that cannot be graded. Problems and questions can be unresolved; an answer outside the reviewed variants is unrecognized or ungraded.
findings.suggestion: Replace the clause with «відповіді, яких немає серед перевірених варіантів, не вважаються помилками».

items.notes: Required steps within an optional lesson do not themselves create a contradiction.
sources: Ukrainian academic dictionary SUM-11, entry «розв’язувати», senses concerning solving problems and answering questions (from memory).

findings.location: context.taughtBefore[2] and context.targets[2].description: «Прикметники на -e та на приголосну: одна форма для обох родів»
findings.description: The description incorrectly treats consonant-final adjectives as uniformly invariant in gender. Common A1 adjectives include español/española and trabajador/trabajadora. The forms required by this exercise are nevertheless correct.
findings.suggestion: Describe the illustrated invariant adjectives specifically, or qualify the generalization and distinguish consonant-final adjectives that change gender.

items.notes: The feedback «Ключі твої — mis» can correctly address the learner as the owner speaking about their own keys; it is not necessarily a mistranslation of mis.
sources: Review duties: false rules or misleading simplifications.
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entries «español, la» and «trabajador, ra» (from memory).

findings.location: context.taughtBefore[2] and context.targets[2].description: «Прикметники на -e та на приголосну: одна форма для обох родів»; task.hints[1].blocks[0].text: «Після приголосної в множині додаємо -es.»
findings.description: The adjective description overgeneralizes: español/española demonstrates gender variation after a consonant. The plural hint also presents an unrestricted consonant rule, although nouns such as lunes remain unchanged. The answer hoteles grandes is correct.
findings.suggestion: Limit the adjective description to the invariant patterns illustrated. Scope the plural hint to this ending: «Іменники на -l утворюють множину за допомогою -es: hotel → hoteles.»

items.notes: The key, error outcomes and target attribution are otherwise consistent.
sources: Review duties: false rules or misleading simplifications.
